records.source: The warm climate of the southern ocean allows for extreme biodiversity... in short, the island is teeming with life!
records.translation: Dahil sa mainit na klima ng katimugang karagatan, napakataas ng sari-saring buhay... sa madaling salita, hitik sa buhay ang isla!

records.source: Now we move north to the bustle of Zuzu City. It's a world of concrete and steel, illuminated by the glow of city light.
records.translation: Tutungo naman tayo pahilaga sa mataong Lungsod ng Zuzu. Mundo ito ng kongkreto at bakal na naliliwanagan ng kislap ng mga ilaw ng lungsod.

records.source: The conditions may be harsh, but still, we find abundant life...
records.translation: Maaaring malupit ang mga kalagayan, ngunit makikita pa rin natin ang saganang buhay...

records.source: Far to the west, alone in the vast Gem Sea, lies Prairie Island. In spite of its name, this land is home to a diverse array of natural biomes.
records.translation: Sa malayong kanluran, nag-iisa sa malawak na Dagat ng Gem, matatagpuan ang Isla ng Kapatagan. Sa kabila ng pangalan nito, tahanan ang lupaing ito ng sari-saring likas na biome.

records.source: The island is known for its abundant population of raccoons!
records.translation: Kilala ang isla sa napakaraming rakun nito!

records.source: Finally, we return to the mainland, to visit one of the most pleasant areas of the continent... Stardew Valley.
records.translation: Sa wakas, babalik tayo sa kalupaan upang bisitahin ang isa sa pinakakaaya-ayang lugar sa kontinente... ang Stardew Valley.

records.source: The temperate climate of the valley is the perfect home for a variety of woodland creatures and insects. What a beautiful place!
records.translation: Ang katamtamang klima ng lambak ay perpektong tahanan ng sari-saring hayop at insekto sa kakahuyan. Napakagandang lugar!

records.source: It Howls In The Rain
A group of youngsters set out to discover the source of a mysterious sound. (Parental Supervision Required)
records.translation: Isang grupo ng kabataan ang naghahanap sa pinagmulan ng isang mahiwagang tunog. (Kailangan ang Patnubay ng Magulang)

records.source: It Howls In The Rain
'The following footage was salvaged from an abandoned camcorder 30 miles south of Grampleton'
records.translation: “Ang sumusunod na bidyo ay nasagip mula sa isang iniwang camcorder 30 milya sa timog ng Grampleton”

records.source: 'Did you hear that? I think it came from those woods... Let's go...'
records.translation: “Narinig mo iyon? Sa tingin ko, galing iyon sa gubat... Tara...”

records.source: '(Heavy Breathing)... Look!'
(The camera lurches forward into the forest)
records.translation: (Biglang sumusugod ang kamera papasok sa gubat)

records.source: 'Oh, it's just you, Gary... *pant* *pant*... Stop grabbing my arm!'
records.translation: “Ah, ikaw lang pala, Gary... *hingal* *hingal*... Huwag mong sunggaban ang braso ko!”

records.source: Agh!
records.preserveReason: Fictional proper title intentionally retained unchanged in Filipino.

records.source: 'Look! It's in the bush...'
Aiii!
records.preserveReason: Fictional proper title intentionally retained unchanged in Filipino.

records.source: Oh...
(Muffled cries and a strange shuffling sound can be heard)
records.translation: (Maririnig ang pigil na mga sigaw at kakaibang kaluskos)

records.source: It's still out there...
